claims.text: H.I.S. summer-vacation reservation data reported Singapore bookings from Japan up 22.8% year on year.
The 2026 National Day Parade is at the National Stadium and gates open at 4:30 p.m. on show days.
The official estimated walks to National Stadium are 13 minutes from Kallang MRT and 11 minutes from Tanjong Rhu MRT; several nearby bus stops and taxi stands are affected on the actual event day.
Official NDP advisories include National Stadium entry conditions, prohibited items, road traffic information, and aerial-activity restrictions.
Singapore National Day falls on Sunday 9 August 2026; Monday 10 August is a public holiday when the employee's rest day falls on 9 August.

Non-Singapore passport holders generally need at least six months' passport validity, and most travelers must submit the free SG Arrival Card within three days including the day of arrival; visa requirements depend on the passport or travel document.
Singapore Tourism Board lists National Day on 9 August and advises visitors to account for celebration activity and arrive early at popular public areas.

conflicts.issue: Some commercial travel pages still describe the 2026 parade as being at the Padang or imply ticketless entry.
conflicts.resolution: Use the official NDP 2026 site, which places the parade at the National Stadium; do not promise access or a specific fireworks view to travelers without tickets.
